t: What things in this world have a true eternal value? | GotQuestions.org
s: October 24, 2011 - No one comes to the Father except through me” (John 14:6). Everyone is going to live somewhere for all of eternity, Christians and non-Christians alike. And the only eternal destiny other than the one in heaven with Christ is one that provides everlasting punishment for those who reject Him (Matthew 25:46). Regarding the abundant material things this world offers, which many tenaciously seek after, Jesus taught us not to store up for ourselves earthly treasures that can be destroyed or stolen (Matthew 6:19–20).

t: What does the Bible say about things with true eternal value? - Compelling Truth
s: While wealth, power, and even good deeds may keep our memory alive for a time, they still fade. Actual eternal value comes only from what directs people toward Christ and strengthens their walk with Him. The things of this world are temporary, but God’s presence and covenant with His people are lasting (Psalm 16:11; Psalm 73:25–26).
